builder: pyrxd.hd: seed_from_mnemonic / Xprv.from_seed / ckd / Xprv.serialize / Xpub.__str__ / PublicKey.address / PrivateKey.wif
provenance: Expected values generated by bip-utils==2.12.1, an independent BIP32/39/44 implementation with no shared lineage with pyrxd's hd module, via scripts/gen-bip44-derivation-vectors.py. pyrxd is the CONSUMER of this suite, not the reference producer -- the inverse of the dMint V2 suite. CAVEAT: bip-utils and pyrxd share coincurve/libsecp256k1 for EC point math, so a libsecp256k1 arithmetic bug would be invisible here; BIP39 seed derivation/normalization, BIP32 HMAC/CKD, hardened-index math, coin_type path assembly, and xprv/xpub/address/WIF serialization ARE independently covered.
notes: Radiant shares Bitcoin's xprv/xpub version bytes, P2PKH prefix (0x00) and WIF prefix (0x80), so a Bitcoin reference is byte-correct for Radiant mainnet; only the BIP44 coin_type differs. Coin types 0 (Photonic <=v2 / Electron-Radiant), 236 (pre-#14 pyrxd) and 512 (SLIP-0044, pyrxd default) are all live recovery paths -- see src/pyrxd/hd/discovery.py. Entropy values are PRNG fixture material, not secrets: never fund an address derived from them.
